blind.description: A small terracotta or reddish-orange ceramic/plastic watering can or jug. It features a bulbous rounded body with an open top rim, a curved handle on one side, and a short spout with a flared rosette head on the opposite side. The surface is smooth, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, melting, or artifacts. It rests directly flat on the ground on its circular base without an added base slab.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a concentric ring (the open circular rim and neck) flanked on the left by an angled spout and on the right by a looping handle.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely small compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure, measuring around 8 to 10 inches tall (less than 1/6 the height of the figure) and about 1 foot in width from handle to spout tip.
